name: Bulk edit metafields
heading: Bulk edit metafields
description: Build one or more metafield changes, review them, then apply to this product.
description-bulk: Build one or more metafield changes, then apply to {{count}} products.
scope-search-help: Same syntax as the Products admin search. Examples: tag:clearance, status:active, vendor:Acme
scope-truncated: Stopped at {{count}} products (safety limit). Narrow your search or run again in batches.
scope-select-all-warning: Shopify only sends this page of IDs when you use Select all results (usually 50). To update every filtered product, switch to Search / filter query, enter the same filter, then Load products.
scope-need-load: Load products for this scope before reviewing.
op-add-help: Append values to each product’s list (skips duplicates).
op-update-help: Replace the entire metafield value on every product.
op-remove-help: Remove matching values from each product’s list.
op-clear-help: Delete this metafield from every selected product.
values-json-help: For measurement, money, rating, or link list items.
paste-csv-help: Comma or newline separated. Example: zip, express, overnight
gid-paste-help: Paste resource GIDs (one per line or comma-separated).
current-with-without: {{withValue}} of {{sampled}} sampled products have this metafield.
partial-note: Some products may already be updated. Check those products if something looks wrong.
rules-incomplete: Finish each change (metafield, action, and value) before reviewing.
